[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mozambique_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Mozambique to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) with IPC phase classifications, collection dates, and scenario projections for the 2020 medium-term outlook.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys, providing geographic classifications of acute food insecurity severity across administrative areas.
